purpose: exhaustive month-by-month coverage audit of official IDX LINK_DELISTING monthly report; acquisition only, never strategy PnL
non_transient_policy: record exact response, do not hammer and do not use fallback host/source
coverage_checks: Each month 2010-01 through 2026-10 has a raw report response snapshot
Every report response is HTTP 200 and JSON schema has data list plus pagination metadata
Collected row count matches meta.totalItems and every page is fetched if totalItems exceeds pageSize
Required record fields code, issuerName, ListingDate and DeListingDate are present
All source response bytes are preserved or their SHA-256 and payload are committed
No strategy selection, signal, PnL, PF, alpha or universe freezing is performed
verdict_note: A complete monthly response sweep only proves coverage of the published official monthly report for 2010-01 through 2026-10; it does not prove Yahoo daily bars, point-in-time shares/sectors, OHLC quality, or execution costs are adequate.
